name: WarpBuild

billing.notes: Pricing FAQ: "CI runners are billed on a per-minute basis"; per-job rounding of partial minutes is not stated for runners. Cache, snapshots and Docker builders are billed separately. BYOC (runners in your own AWS/GCP/Azure account) costs $0.002/minute on top of your cloud bill and is not listed here. Runner labels: https://www.warpbuild.com/docs/ci/cloud-runners

free_tier.notes: Sign-up without a credit card; the pricing FAQ mentions free usage/credit limits before a payment method is needed, but no amount is published. Not applied in runnerdb prices.

notes: WarpBuild registers as a self-hosted runner; public repositories must be allowed in the runner group settings. Public and private repositories are billed alike.
